{{nihongo|'''Takashino Shrine'''|高石神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izumi Province]].

'''Takashino Shrine''' (たかしのじんじゃ, also read たかいしじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Takaishi, Osaka|ar|تاكايشي (أوساكا)|ca|Takaishi|ce|Такаиси|ceb|Takaishi Shi|de|Takaishi|eo|Takaiŝi|es|Takaishi (Osaka)|et|Takaishi|fa|تاکایشی، اوساکا|fi|Takaishi|fr|Takaishi|gl|Takaishi|he|טקאישי|hy|Տակաիսի|it|Takaishi|ja|高石市|ko|다카이시시|mg|Takaishi|mzn|تاکایشی، اوساکا|nl|Takaishi|pl|Takaishi|pt|Takaishi (Osaka)|ro|Takaishi|ru|Такаиси|simple|Takaishi, Osaka|sv|Takaishi|tg|Такаишӣ|th|ทากาอิชิ|tl|Takaishi, Osaka|tr|Takaishi|tt|Такаиси|uk|Такаїші|ur|ٹاکائیشی، اوساکا|vi|Takaishi, Ōsaka|war|Takaishi, Osaka|zh|高石市|zh_classical|高石市|zh_min_nan|Takaisi-chhī|zh_yue|高石|qid=Q857218}}, {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|Q122723|qid=Q122723}}. Its former rank under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=former shrine ranking system}} was {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}.<ref name="naniwa">[https://www.kansai-u.ac.jp/Museum/naniwa/publication/book18.pdf Kansai University Naniwa/Osaka Cultural Heritage Research Center, Survey Report on Village Life Centered on Shrines (3): Sakai, Kishiwada, Senboku and Sennan Districts in Osaka Prefecture / Hyogo Prefecture], accessed 2019-02-13</ref>

=== History ===
Its founding is unclear, but it is said to have been established in {{ill|650|ab|650|af|650|am|650 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|650|ar|650|ary|650|arz|650|ast|650|avk|650|az|650|azb|۶۵۰ (میلادی)|ban|650|bar|650|be|650|be_x_old|650|bg|650|bn|৬৫০|bpy|মারি ৬৫০|br|650|bs|650.|ca|650|cdo|650 nièng|ceb|650|ckb|٦٥٠|crh|650|cs|650|cv|650|cy|650|da|650|de|650|el|650|eml|650|eo|650|es|650|et|650|eu|650|fa|۶۵۰ (میلادی)|fi|650|fo|650|fr|650|fur|650|fy|650|ga|650|gan|650年|gd|650|gl|650|gv|650|he|650|hi|650|hr|650.|ht|650 (almanak jilyen)|hu|650|hy|650|id|650|io|650|it|650|ja|650年|jv|650|ka|650|kk|650 жыл|ko|650년|la|650|lb|650|lij|650|lmo|650|lt|650 m.|lv|650. gads|map_bms|650|mdf|650|mg|650|mhr|650|mk|650|mr|इ.स. ६५०|mrj|650 и|ms|650|mzn|۶۵۰|nah|650|nap|650|nds|650|nds_nl|650|new|सन् ६५०|nl|650|nn|650|no|650|nrm|650|nso|650|oc|650|or|୬୫୦|os|650-æм аз|pl|650|pnb|650|pt|650|qu|650|ro|650|ru|650 год|rue|650|sa|६५०|scn|650|sd|650ع|se|650|sh|650.|shn|650|si|650|sk|650|sl|650|sq|650|sr|650|su|650|sv|650|sw|650|tg|Соли 650|th|พ.ศ. 1193|tk|650|tl|650|tly|650|tr|650|tt|650 ел|uk|650|ur|650ء|uz|650|vec|650|vi|650|war|650|wuu|650年|xmf|650|zh|650年|zh_min_nan|650 nî|zh_yue|650年|qid=Q30179}} (year 1 of {{ill|Hakuchi (era)|de|Hakuchi (Ära)|es|Hakuchi (era)|fa|هاکوچی (دوره)|fr|Ère Hakuchi|hr|Hakuchi (razdoblje)|ia|Hakuchi (era)|id|Hakuchi|ja|白雉|ko|하쿠치|ru|Хакути|sh|Hakuchi (era)|simple|Hakuchi (era)|sr|Хакучи|th|ฮากูจิ (ศักราช)|tr|Hakuchi (dönem)|uk|Хакуті|zh|白雉|zh_yue|白雉|qid=Q540118}}), and it is a shrine recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}}.<ref name="高石市">[http://www.city.takaishi.lg.jp/politics/shoukai/1536909791046.html Tourist spots in Takaishi - Takaishi City], accessed 2019-02-13</ref>
Until recent years, votive sumo bouts offered in thanks for fulfilled prayers by sailors were dedicated here.

=== Events ===
* January 1, 6:00 - "New Year's Day Festival"
* February 3 - "Star Festival for warding off misfortune," 17:00 - "Setsubun Festival"
* October, weekend before "Sports Day" - "Autumn Grand Festival"
* November 15 - "Shichi-Go-San"
* December 31, 24:00 - "Misoka Festival"

=== Prayer services ===
Recovery from illness, physical health, prosperous business, household safety, safe childbirth, success in relationships, academic success, success in examinations, prayers for employment, fulfillment of wishes, gratitude for divine blessings, first shrine visit for newborns, Shichi-Go-San visit, coming-of-age report, car purification, traffic safety, and direction-based purification.
